metadata.title: Why a Sharp-Momentum Particle Must Be Everywhere at Once
metadata.thing: a single endless flat-amplitude wave, then a stack of slightly different waves summing into one localized packet
metadata.color_notes: The wave / packet = accent Warm Slate #5A5653. The momentum dots = ink. The flat 'everywhere' probability + closing emphasis = red #C0392B.

beats.start_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a small friendly bear, full body, standing, looking up with curiosity]
beats.video_animation_prompt: the bear draws itself in stroke by stroke, no hand visible, white background; then the title appears in Shadows Into Light
beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: A free particle with one exact momentum sounds like the simplest thing in physics.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A free particle with one exact momentum sounds like the simplest thing in physics.
beats.new_visual_element: a person confidently holding a single labelled momentum arrow
beats.start_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a person confidently holding a single arrow labelled with one momentum]
beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the person proud of one clean momentum arrow]
beats.video_animation_prompt: the person and a single clean momentum arrow draw in; the person looks confident; no hand visible, white background, napkin art doodle style
beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: But its wave fills all of space equally — so it's literally nowhere in particular.
beats.tts_normalized_text: But its wave fills all of space equally — so it's literally nowhere in particular.
beats.new_visual_element: the person baffled, the particle smeared across everywhere
beats.start_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = a person baffled as a particle is smeared evenly across the whole scene]
beats.end_frame_prompt: [DOODLE OBJECT = the person shrugging at a particle that is everywhere at once]
beats.video_animation_prompt: the person draws in; the particle smears out to fill everywhere evenly; the person is baffled; no hand visible, white background, napkin art doodle style
beats.negative_prompt: hand, fingers, arm, pencil, pen, marker, stylus, writing tool, shadow, paper texture, yellowing, gradient, photorealistic, 3D render, gray shading, color, brush, eraser, artifacts, distortion, camera movement, zoom, pan, wiggle, blur

beats.narration_text: One exact momentum is one pure wave, the same height from end to end.
beats.tts_normalized_text: One exact momentum is one pure wave, the same height from end to end.
beats.new_visual_element: a single endless constant-amplitude wave + one momentum dot
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw one pure wave of constant amplitude across the whole frame, with a single dot on a small momentum axis

beats.narration_text: Square it and the probability is the same everywhere — an infinite smear that can't even be normalized.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Square it and the probability is the same everywhere — an infinite smear that can't even be normalized.
beats.new_visual_element: a flat probability line across the whole frame, marked 'everywhere'
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw a flat |psi|^2 line spanning the frame, labelled 'same everywhere — can't be normalized'

beats.narration_text: To put the particle somewhere, you have to add nearby momenta.
beats.tts_normalized_text: To put the particle somewhere, you have to add nearby momenta.
beats.new_visual_element: the flat line clears; we prepare to add more waves
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: clear the flat probability line and prepare the momentum axis to receive more dots

beats.narration_text: Add a few neighbors and the wave starts to bunch up and thin out.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Add a few neighbors and the wave starts to bunch up and thin out.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: add two more momentum dots and transform the wave to the sum of three — beats / partial bunching appear

beats.narration_text: Add more, and the bunching grows sharper in the middle.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Add more, and the bunching grows sharper in the middle.
beats.new_visual_element: six momenta summed: a clearer central lump
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: add more momentum dots and transform the wave to the sum of six — a clearer central lump forms

beats.narration_text: With many momenta they reinforce in one spot and cancel everywhere else.
beats.tts_normalized_text: With many momenta they reinforce in one spot and cancel everywhere else.
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: add a full band of momentum dots and transform the wave to a localized packet — flat everywhere except one blob

beats.narration_text: Now the probability is a single bump — the particle is finally somewhere.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Now the probability is a single bump — the particle is finally somewhere.
beats.new_visual_element: a single probability bump under the packet
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: draw a single |psi|^2 bump under the packet, labelled 'one place'

beats.narration_text: One momentum is everywhere; a definite place takes a whole spread of momenta.
beats.tts_normalized_text: One momentum is everywhere; a definite place takes a whole spread of momenta.
beats.new_visual_element: red label 'one momentum: everywhere — a place needs many'
beats.video_animation_prompt: MANIM: settle the packet and write a red label 'one momentum: everywhere; a place needs many'; clean close
